items.title: 「荒野行動」×「NARUTO-ナルト- 疾風伝」コラボ第2弾が本日スタート。敵車両を妨害する車両スキル「月読」を持つSP枠EVセダンが登場

zh.title: 《荒野行动》与《火影忍者疾风传》的第二次合作今日开启。推出具有阻碍敌方车辆的车辆技能“Tsukuyomi”的 SP 框架 EV 轿车。

en.title: The second collaboration between “Wilderness Action” and “NARUTO Shippuden” starts today. Introducing an SP frame EV sedan with the vehicle skill “Tsukuyomi” that obstructs enemy vehicles.
en.summary: NetEaseGames today (October 31, 2026) started the second collaboration event with the anime "NARUTO Shippuden" in the battle royale game "Wilderness Action". Introducing Weasel's EV sedan, which has the vehicle skill "Tsukuyomi" that obstructs enemy vehicles. By participating in the event, you can get up to 100 consecutive free gachas and gold frame costumes of your choice.

items.title: 新作謎解きADV「The Orphaned House」が，ゲーム分野としては初となる“人間制作”の認証を取得。DLCやアプデでも基準順守を求められる
items.summary: 23Firstは2026年10月29日，CharmGamesが開発中の一人称視点アドベンチャー「TheOrphanedHouse」が，民間認証サービス「ProudlyHuman」（人間制作）の認証を取得したと発表した。同サービスのゲーム分野では初の事例となり，作品の画像や宣伝素材に認証マークを表示できる。

zh.title: 全新解谜ADV《孤儿院》成为游戏领域首个获得“人类制作”认证的游戏。DLC和更新也需要符合标准。
zh.summary: 23First于2026年10月29日宣布，CharmGames正在开发的第一人称冒险游戏《TheOrphanedHouse》已获得私人认证服务“ProudlyHuman”的认证。这是该服务在游戏领域的首例，允许在作品的图像和宣传材料上显示认证标志。

en.title: The new puzzle-solving ADV ``The Orphaned House'' has become the first in the game field to receive certification as ``human production.'' DLC and updates are also required to comply with standards.
en.summary: 23First announced on October 29, 2026 that the first-person adventure game "TheOrphanedHouse" being developed by CharmGames has been certified by the private certification service "ProudlyHuman." This is the first example of this service in the game field, allowing the certification mark to be displayed on images and promotional materials of works.

ja.summary: 先週の水曜日、57歳のグレッグ・ゼシュクさんはカナダのブリティッシュ・コロンビア州中部のバビン川でニジマス釣りをしていたところ、BioWare氏死亡のニュースが流れた。ゼシュクは釣りに集中するため携帯電話の電源を切った。その日遅く、ゼシュクさんが川から別荘に戻ると、携帯電話にテキストメッセージが流れ込んでいるのに気づきました。 「10通近くのテキストメッセージを受け取りました」とゼシュクさんは語った。 「携帯電話の電源を入れるとすぐに、誰かが私にお悔やみのメッセージを送ってきたのが見えました。『BioWare に起こったことについて深くお詫び申し上げます』。当時の私の最初の反応は、『BioWare はなくなってしまった!』でした」 グレッグ ゼシュクの最近の写真 1995 年、ゼシュクはレイ ムジカおよびオーガスティン イェと共同で BioWare を設立しました。過去 30 年間にわたり、BioWare は「Baldur's Gate」、「Mass Effect」、「Dragon Age」などの高く評価されたゲームを数多く作成し、ロールプレイングを再定義してきました。

en.title: BioWare co-founder: EA executives have never made games, closing the studio is not an accident
en.summary: Last Wednesday, 57-year-old Greg Zeschuk was fishing for rainbow trout on the Babine River in central British Columbia, Canada, when news of BioWare's death spread. In order to concentrate on fishing, Zeshuk turned off his mobile phone. Later that day, Zeshuk returned to his vacation cabin from the river to find a stream of text messages pouring into his phone. "I received almost 10 text messages," Zeshuk said. "As soon as I turned on my phone, I saw someone sending me a message to express condolences: 'I am deeply sorry for what happened to BioWare.' My first reaction at the time was: 'BioWare is gone!'" A recent photo of Greg Zeshuk In 1995, Zeshuk co-founded BioWare with Ray Muzica and Augustine Ye. Over the past 30 years, BioWare has created many highly regarded games such as "Baldur's Gate", "Mass Effect" and "Dragon Age", and even redefined role-playing.

ja.summary: 「Red Desert: Enhanced Edition」「Unknown Journey」拡張パックが全世界で正式にリリースされました。 「Unknown Journey」は「Red Desert: Enhanced Edition」の最初のDLCであると報告されています。パベルを守ることに成功したクリフ、オンカ、デミアンがそれぞれの未来を切り開き、人生の目標を見つける物語を描く。冒険の舞台はパヴェルから広大な海と水中世界へと広がります。プレイヤーは手作りの船を海に送り出し、新しい島を探索したり、深海に潜って隠された宝物、遺跡、未知の秘密を発見したりできます。恋愛やビジネスなどのゲームをプレイすることで、パベルの人生もよりカラフルになります。クリフ、オンカ、デミアンはパベルの住人たちと信頼関係を築き、恋愛関係や結婚にまで発展します。プレイヤーは解放された拠点の施設を借りて運営し、富を蓄積することもできます。拡張された住宅建設システムでは、室内装飾がサポートされるだけでなく、壁、窓、その他の建物構造の配置をプレイヤーが個人的にデザインできるようになります。

en.title: "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition" "Unknown Journey" expansion pack officially launched globally
en.summary: "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition" "Unknown Journey" expansion pack is officially launched globally. It is reported that "Unknown Journey" is the first DLC of "Red Desert: Enhanced Edition". It depicts the story of Cliff, Onka and Demian who successfully protected Pavel, each opening their own path in the future and finding their goals in life. The stage of adventure extends from Pavel to the vast ocean and underwater world. Players can drive a hand-built ship out to sea, explore new islands, or dive into the deep sea to discover hidden treasures, ruins, and unknown secrets. Playing games such as love and business will also make Pavel's life more colorful. Cliff, Onka, and Demian can build trust with the residents of Pavel, leading to romantic relationships and even marriages. Players can also rent and operate facilities in liberated strongholds to accumulate wealth. The expanded home construction system not only supports interior decoration, but also allows players to personally design the placement of walls, windows and other building structures.

en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. “Four thumbs up” (Photo/Ronaldo) Last weekend, I finally made up my mind and took the PS5 for repair. The reason why I say "relentless" is because I am the kind of player who is very dazed. I can spend an hour or two tinkering with "how to play the Chinese version of "Arknights: The End" in the Steamdeck. I can also procrastinate on the problem of PS5 overheating and shutting down for more than half a year, thinking, "It's not a big problem!" Since the beginning of this year, my PS5 will roar and roar from time to time, and then the "PS5 temperature is too high" reminder will flash on the screen. At first, I just thought it was an optimization problem of the game, thinking that I would just wait for it to cool down on its own and wait for a while. Under this situation, I even played through "The Lonely Shadow", "Marvel's Spider-Man 2"...especially "Marvel's Spider-Man 2", and entered the laboratory to eliminate pests and DNA.
